source_note: Extra IELTS Part 3 topics typed from the owner's screenshots of a Part 3 question list (sent 26 November 2026, topics 2-33, all marked 'Predicted & Reported: September 2026 - April 2027'). General Training only; not linked to a cue card. Topics merge with existing Part 3 topics of the same title ('app_title' shows the name in the list when it differs), and questions already in a topic are skipped.
not_typed: Cities: 2 of 10 questions were below the screenshot.

Money, Travelling, Teaching/learning, Happiness: 1 question each was below the screenshot.

fixes_applied: Removed '(added on ...)' and '(frequently asked)' notes and the '(Predicted & Reported ...)' part of titles.

Merged into existing topics: 'Making noise' -> Noise; 'Memory, history' and 'Learning history' -> History; 'Service, shopping' -> Shopping; 'Time management, daily routine' -> Daily routine; 'Movies' -> Films; 'Sports' -> Athletes, sports; 'Photos' -> Photography.
'Being organised' (1 question, 'How can parents help children to be organized?') is the same as 'How can parents teach children to be organized?' in Losing things, so it is not a separate topic.

Matched existing wording: 'How can we avoid or reduce the possibility of losing things?' -> 'How can we avoid losing things?'; 'In your view, should children be taught to help others?' -> '... to help others and to be kind to them?'.
Buildings listed 'Is it hard to protect historical buildings?' twice; kept once. Reading and Happiness/Photos screenshots overlapped; each question kept once.
'Do you prefer book or movies?' -> 'books or movies'; 'teach children save money' -> 'teach children to save money'.
